! Game text
| Deploy at any site. Cannot be moved. You may either: Add 1 to weapon destiny for each of your automated weapons there or at adjacent sites. OR A character at an adjacent site you control may add its power to a battle at Holocam's site. || {{Errata hl|Deploy on a site}}. {{Errata hl|Adds 1 to the total weapon destiny of each of your automated weapons at same and adjacent sites}}. {{Errata hl|During battle, may add the power of one of your characters at an adjacent site you control to your total}}.
